title: psoralea platyphylla
intro: Psoralea platyphylla, commonly known as Huang Qi, is a plant species in the legume family. It is valued for its health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea platyphylla include stimulating the immune system and promoting tissue repair, which can aid in the healing process and reduce the risk of infection. Bioactive constituents of Psoralea platyphylla include isoflavones and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
